sources.source_name: Masonite Performance Door System Product Page
sources.snippet: Masonite Performance Door System features fiberglass composite construction with polyurethane foam core. System includes pre-hung frame with weatherstripping and adjustable hinges. Available in smooth and textured finishes.
sources.classification_reason: Core product specification — confirms slab type and insulation

sources.snippet: Masonite International Corporation (TSX: MAS) is a global manufacturer of interior and exterior doors. Publicly traded, manufactures across US, Canada, and Mexico facilities. Performance line positioned as premium above Solidoor value tier.
sources.classification_reason: Corporate structure — report finding, no score impact

sources.source_name: Contractor forum consensus — Masonite vs Therma-Tru comparison
sources.snippet: Professional installers generally rank Masonite Performance comparable to Therma-Tru Benchmark but with better weatherstrip integration out of the box. Slab quality is standard compression-molded fiberglass, not salon-grade like Therma-Tru Classic-Craft AccuGrain. Serviceable for $500K-750K homes but not specified for premium custom.
sources.classification_reason: Professional hierarchy placement affects tier and quality axis

sources.snippet: Masonite Performance Door System uses a compression-type weatherstripping system with improved corner pads vs their Solidoor line. Threshold is standard aluminum sill. Water penetration resistance is adequate but not in the same class as Therma-Tru Classic-Craft multi-layer system.
sources.classification_reason: Weatherstripping quality directly affects quality and performance axes

sources.source_name: Home improvement forum — Masonite door hardware
sources.snippet: Masonite Performance comes standard with single deadbolt, Grade 2 hardware. No multipoint lock option in the Performance line. Hinges are Grade 2 plain steel. Hardware is adequate for the price point but not premium.
sources.classification_reason: Hardware grade directly affects quality axis scoring

sources.snippet: Masonite fiberglass entry doors with polyurethane foam core achieve U-factors in the 0.20-0.25 range for solid panel configurations. ENERGY STAR certified for most climate zones. Air infiltration rated at approximately 0.15-0.18 cfm/sq ft per ASTM E283.
sources.classification_reason: NFRC energy performance data affects performance axis

sources.snippet: Masonite Performance Door System carries a limited lifetime warranty on fiberglass slab against manufacturing defects. Glass warranty is 10 years. Finish warranty is limited and varies by product. Warranty is transferable to second owner with registration.

Masonite Performance has fewer water intrusion issues than comparable steel doors. Minor finish fade reported after 7-10 years without re-staining. Weatherstrip replacement is possible but uses proprietary sizing. Overall callback rate is moderate — better than JELD-WEN builder, worse than Therma-Tru dealer products.
sources.classification_reason: Field callback data directly affects durability scoring

sources.snippet: Replacement parts for Masonite doors available through manufacturer direct and authorized dealers. Weatherstripping uses proprietary sizing — standard kerf replacements may not fit perfectly. Glass panels can be ordered directly but lead time is 4-6 weeks.

Masonite Performance Door System available through both dealer channel and some big-box retailers. Unlike Therma-Tru Classic-Craft (dealer-only), Masonite Performance has mixed distribution. Big-box versions may have slightly different hardware configuration than dealer versions.
sources.classification_reason: Channel quality affects scoring — mixed distribution noted

bottom_line: Masonite Performance Door System is a solid mid-market fiberglass entry door comparable to Therma-Tru Benchmark. It features standard fiberglass construction with polyurethane foam core, improved weatherstripping system (better than JELD-WEN), and adequate Grade 2 hardware. Good energy performance with ENERGY STAR certification. Not premium quality but serviceable for most homes. Limited research depth due to Perplexity data availability constraints.
